picks.editorial_note: A combined $1B+ commitment from Georgia Tech and Emory is one of the largest university AI investments of the year, aimed at anchoring Georgia as a national AI hub for jobs and economic growth.
picks.title: Georgia Tech and Emory Invest More Than $1B in AI to Drive State’s Jobs, Economic Growth

picks.editorial_note: A White House-backed consortium of 15 universities across 10 states pooling supercomputing resources signals a new model of federally coordinated academic AI infrastructure.
picks.title: UK partners with regional universities in super intelligence computing consortium

picks.editorial_note: SLAC's lead role in a DOE Genesis Mission award marks a concrete step in a major federal push to embed AI-driven 'super intelligence' discovery methods across the national lab system.
picks.title: SLAC to lead a Department of Energy Genesis Mission project for Super Intelligence (SI)-driven autonomous discovery in catalysis

picks.editorial_note: Phase II Genesis Mission funding for Berkeley Lab's accelerator-design AI project shows the DOE scaling up its bet on AI-accelerated physics research with real follow-on dollars.
picks.title: Super Intelligence for Particle Accelerators Gets Another Boost

picks.editorial_note: Georgia Tech's $20M NSF-funded Nexus supercomputer, opened to researchers nationwide in partnership with UIUC, expands shared AI compute capacity for the broader research community.
picks.title: Georgia Tech Opens Supercomputer to Researchers Nationwide

picks.editorial_note: SLAC's SPIRE project pushes toward fully autonomous, AI-agent-run laboratories for photon science — a tangible step toward self-driving scientific discovery.
picks.title: SLAC leads new project to build the self-driving laboratory of the future

picks.editorial_note: Fermilab's two new Genesis Mission awards apply AI to chip design and quantum information science, extending the DOE's AI-for-science initiative into semiconductors and quantum tech.
picks.title: Fermilab to lead two new Genesis Mission awards to accelerate development of microelectronics and quantum

picks.editorial_note: CMU's Ataraxos, published in Nature, beats top humans at Stratego, a benchmark requiring reasoning under hidden information — a notable advance in imperfect-information AI.
picks.title: CMU Researchers Develop AI That Tackles Hidden Information in Stratego

picks.editorial_note: Google.org's $5M commitment to Georgia Tech lowers the barrier for researchers to access AI tools and computing for scientific discovery, broadening who can do AI-driven science.
picks.title: Georgia Tech Receives $5 Million From Google.org to Expand Access to AI for Scientific Discovery

picks.editorial_note: NASA's SSPICY mission demonstrates autonomous, computer-vision-based satellite inspection with minimal ground control — a real-world application of AI autonomy in space operations.
picks.title: NASA’s SSPICY Mission to Demonstrate In-Space Inspection Technologies - NASA
